labs.title: Jacobian and inverse kinematics
labs.outcome: Distinguish singularity, reachability and solver limits.
labs.scopeNote: Original numerical self-check for a declared planar 2R arm: endpoint Jacobian, singularity, analytic IK branches with joint limits and an honest bounded numerical solver. No spatial/6D Jacobian, orientation IK, dynamics or hardware evidence.

labs.title: Trajectories
labs.outcome: Construct a time law with endpoint and derivative bounds.
labs.scopeNote: Implemented: a one-axis rest-to-rest triangular/trapezoidal time law under |v| <= vmax and |a| <= amax, with type choice, phase times, minimum duration, position/velocity/acceleration sampling, reversed and zero-displacement moves, slower profiles of a requested duration, honest rejection of impossible durations, and the common duration of two independent joints. The kit checks endpoints, continuity and limit bounds numerically. Entirely numerical; no hardware, simulator or robot execution.
unavailable: Jerk-limited (S-curve) or higher-order profiles and any jerk claim
Torque, motor, payload or dynamics limits
Multi-segment, via-point or Cartesian/path trajectories and path geometry
Controller tracking, sample-time effects and execution on a real robot or simulator
Automatic phase-boundary error diagnosis beyond the kit's named endpoint, continuity and bound messages
Signed or verified evidence

labs.title: Localization
labs.outcome: Update a finite belief under explicit measurement assumptions.
labs.scopeNote: Original numerical self-check for a declared 1-D corridor of n cells: exact Bayes sensor update with normalization and an explicit error on an impossible reading, noisy motion kernel with ring or wall rules, sense-then-move loop and ambiguity from symmetric layouts, plus deterministic particle weights, effective sample size and systematic resampling from an explicit draw u0. Numerical toy only: no SLAM, no continuous state, no random-draw convergence statistics, no real sensor, simulator or hardware evidence.
unavailable: Particle-filter convergence statistics on random draws
SLAM or map building
Continuous-state, 2-D/3-D or heading localization

labs.title: Kalman and fusion
labs.outcome: Check prediction, update and covariance assumptions.
labs.scopeNote: Original numerical/replay self-check for a declared scalar or 2-state constant-velocity linear-Gaussian model with one scalar measurement: predict, innovation and gain, Joseph/standard update inside a symmetric-PSD band, sequential fusion checked against the batch information form, covariance validity and NIS on a replay with dropouts. Conditional on the declared F, Q, H, R; no blanket covariance guarantee, no hardware or real sensor data.
unavailable: Ensemble consistency statistics (Monte-Carlo NIS/NEES) over random draws with an explicit false-failure policy
EKF, UKF and other nonlinear estimators
Vector measurements and models beyond two states
Correlated-noise handling beyond a declared counterexample in practice
Estimating or tuning Q and R from data
Time-offset and out-of-order measurement handling
Real sensor data, calibration or hardware evidence

labs.title: Search and planning
labs.outcome: Find paths and check swept collision geometry.
labs.scopeNote: Original numerical self-check of 2D occupancy-grid A* (4- or 8-connected, costs 1 and sqrt(2), explicit no-corner-cutting rule), a tight admissible heuristic, a deterministic expansion-budget search that reports budget_exhausted separately from unreachable, and exact closed segment-vs-rectangle and swept-square tests, compared with an exhaustive Dijkstra and exact rational geometry on small cases. Numerical only: no simulator, hardware, RRT/PRM or arm planning.
unavailable: RRT, RRT* or PRM sampling planners and any completeness or probabilistic-completeness claim from a run
Arm or configuration-space (C-space) planning and joint-space collision checking
Continuous-space or any-angle planning beyond a single straight-segment check
Robot footprints other than an axis-aligned square, heading, kinematic or dynamic constraints
Moving or unknown obstacles, costmaps, replanning and localisation error
Simulator runs, ROS integration and real-robot evidence

labs.title: Executive and safety
labs.outcome: Check preconditions, cancellation and fault transitions.
labs.scopeNote: Original numerical/replay self-check of a deterministic plain state machine for a declared mock pick-and-deliver task: 11 states (a hold state per active phase), 11 events with integer-millisecond timestamps, guarded transitions, a watchdog (observation older than max_age stops motion and enters a hold state; age equal to max_age is fresh), fault and cancel priority, bounded retry and explicit resume with no automatic re-entry, trace replay returning states and emitted commands, and a trace monitor for no motion command while stale, cancelled or faulted. Checked against hand-written tables and exhaustive short event sequences. Simulation only: no hardware, real stop, ROS timing, behaviour-tree library, hazard review or certification.
unavailable: Human hazard-analysis review of the state table and recovery paths
Safety certification or any claim that the machine is a safety function
Real emergency stop, actuator, gripper or hardware fault injection
Behaviour-tree libraries and BT-specific semantics
ROS nodes, real-time scheduling and timer or clock failure modes
Concurrent or asynchronous events, message loss and command acknowledgement
Fault injection on a simulator or real robot

labs.title: Camera and calibration
labs.outcome: Project and validate synthetic camera geometry.
labs.scopeNote: Original numerical/replay self-check on synthetic geometry only: ideal pinhole intrinsics (fx, fy, cx, cy; no distortion), a declared world-to-camera rotation and translation, projection and deprojection with positive depth and rejection of zero, negative or behind-camera depth, reprojection RMS, and a linear intrinsic fit (two independent least-squares lines from known camera-frame points) evaluated on a stated train/held-out split, checked against exact rational arithmetic. No images, detection, lens model or device calibration; a small error here does not validate a real camera.
unavailable: Real image input, rendered images or replayed camera frames
Checkerboard or corner detection
Full Zhang-style calibration with unknown extrinsics per view
Lens distortion models beyond the ideal pinhole, and undistortion
PnP and camera pose estimation
Stereo, depth sensors and rolling-shutter effects
Device calibration, hand-eye calibration and any hardware evidence

labs.title: Data QA and imitation
labs.outcome: Check data alignment, split integrity and evaluation protocol.
labs.scopeNote: Original numerical self-check on tiny in-memory episode lists: named QA defects (empty, length mismatch, non-increasing timestamps, gaps above a declared maximum, NaN or infinity, out-of-range values), exact duplicate episodes, an action/observation lag search, whole-session train/test splits with an id leakage audit, and a closed-form least-squares line fitted on training episodes only and compared on held-out episodes with a mean-action baseline. Numerical toy only: no neural network, LeRobot or real robot data, closed-loop rollout, multi-dimensional observations or generalization claim.

labs.title: Identification
labs.outcome: Separate parameter fit from identifiability.
labs.scopeNote: Original numerical/replay self-check for a declared discrete first-order model y[k+1] = a y[k] + b u[k] on small synthetic logs: simulation, 2x2 normal equations, least-squares fit with exact recovery on noise-free data, held-out one-step residual, Gram-matrix condition number with identifiable/weak/unidentifiable classification (unidentifiable logs raise ValueError), parameter standard deviation, and deterministic bounded uniform or log-uniform randomisation from explicit draws. Conditional on the declared model; synthetic logs only, no robot, no physics backend, not verified sim-to-real.
unavailable: Physics-backend (simulator) system identification
